== Moved from Virtual Block 6 to Virtual Block 1 (2026-10-20) ==

Comlink Cursor, at Bill's request (2026-10-20):
* '''Set''' changed from Virtual Block 6 to [[Virtual Block 1]]. ''VirtualBlock1.pdf'' (official text as of 7 December 2009) prints this card on page 2 (Dark Side) as '''02E''' with the Virtual Block 1 icon. The footer slip is titled "•Motti (V)". No Block 6 PDF (6.1, 6.2, 6.3) contains it. The 2014 master list also shows it with the Block 1 icon.
* card_uid is now <code>pc|vb1|Dark|admiralmottibattlestationcoordinator.gif</code>. prev/next are now [[Admiral Motti (V) (Virtual Block 1)|Admiral Motti (V) (Dark)]] / [[Assault Rifle (V)]], matching 01E / 03 order in the PDF.
* '''Image left alone''' (image work is on hold): the file is still [[:File:VB6-D-admiralmottibattlestationcoordinator-pre.gif]], with a VB6 prefix. The picture itself is the VB1 02E card (Block 1 icon). A VB1-named file can follow when image work resumes.
* Why two Mottis in Block 1: Decipher printed two Motti cards, Premiere [[Admiral Motti]] (1_164) and Jedi Pack [[Motti]] (102_10). Virtual Set 2 #26 Admiral Motti (V) and Virtual Set 3 #40 Motti (V) went over them. The August 2009 Holotable errata lists both reprints. Admiral Motti_E is on the Premiere card. Admiral Motti, Battlestation Coordinator_E is on the Jedi Pack card, tagged Set: Virtual Set 18: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=450849#p450849 forum p=450849] (JarJarDrinks, 25 August 2009; Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020194313/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t29990.html Internet Archive]). Both ended up in Block 1 as 01E and 02E.
* The 2011 report that the card list had it under Block 6: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=610868#p610868 forum p=610868] (JediJer, 30 March 2011; Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020194139/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p610868.html Internet Archive]). The res.starwarsccg.org VBlock6Type list still has it today. VBlock1Type does not (Wayback 2012-07-21, 2013-12, 2026).
* Inference, not in the article: Virtual Set 18 later became Block 6.1. A new title tagged Virtual Set 18 is listed under Block 6. Admiral Motti_E kept its old Virtual Set 2 title and stayed in Block 1.
* Not changed: GEMP has no blueprint for this card; the legacy JSON (swccg-card-json DarkLegacy id 6073) still has set 1006. Evidence and crops: /workspace/vset-master/motti/ on the box. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 19:57, 20 October 2026 (UTC)
